meta.title: WashThru | Automatic Car Wash Machines Made in Saudi Arabia
meta.description: WashThru engineers and manufactures automatic and touchless car wash machines, offering full turnkey solutions from design to after-sale support across Saudi Arabia.

whoWeAre.heading: Who We Are
whoWeAre.intro: Due to the car wash industry's need for development in terms of improving quality and productivity, WashThru was launched to provide smart solutions that help promote the industry's development, increase service quality, and reduce manpower — thus contributing to boosting profits, opening up new car wash investment opportunities, and fostering industry growth.
whoWeAre.missionText: We seek to provide high-quality automated car wash solutions that rely on state-of-the-art AI and IoT technologies, and to export Saudi technology to global markets.

features.heading: Why Businesses Choose WashThru
features.subheading: Every machine we build is engineered locally, tested rigorously, and backed by a nationwide support network.

services.heading: Our Services
services.subheading: From site planning to installation and long-term maintenance, WashThru supports you at every stage.

rollover.description: We have designed the Rollover Machine to serve facilities of limited sizes. Thanks to its unique and natural factor-resistant design, this product has the ability to be placed outdoors without affecting performance or quality, with a capacity up to 3.5 minutes per vehicle.

tunnel.description: We have designed the Tunnel Machine to serve large and medium facilities, as it can wash vehicles sequentially without interruption. As a result, its capacity is up to 1.5 minutes per vehicle.
